content: Discord collection-game bots (Pokétwo, PokéMeow, PokéHunt, Mudae, Karuta) share a consistent table-stakes set: activity-based spawn/encounter, first-to-act capture race, collection/pokedex tracking, leveling+evolution, trading, and PvE/PvP battle. Pokétwo is the genre benchmark: free, open-source, spawns driven by server chat activity (~1 spawn per 24 messages), shiny rarity 1/4096 as chase content, IVs on each catch, market for trading. Monetization is premium tiers (extra rolls, wishlist slots, XP boosters) not paywalled core. Mudae/Karuta prove collection+trading alone can sustain huge playerbases. Distribution: encounter comes FROM user activity, not from the bot pushing events.
